model_acceptance_evidence: Root confirmed the native worker session was explicitly accepted; no independent model introspection
scope: new li_review.py and its tests; single Li labels over fixed ten dates; observational reference and directional revision eligibility only
machine_band_source: readings.SPEC human_bins: existing global pair, or future hit/cont/act pair dictionary; current thresholds are unchanged
basic_consistency_policy: True once seven fixed-ten dates have valid matching observations; False only when all ten comparisons are observable and fewer than seven match; otherwise null. No denominator reduction or final acceptance gate.
directional_evidence_policy: Only valid machine/human disagreements count. Higher and lower are separate; either needs at least three dates. eligible_directions records evidence even if revision_used=1; adjustment_allowed also requires that dimension's revision_used=0. Root decides any adjustment; worker changes nothing.
missing_policy: Omitted rows, blank and literal skip/跳过 are unlabeled; partial core rows preserve each valid dimension and appear in incomplete_dates. Machine unavailable after a valid human label is disclosed and contributes neither matches nor directional disagreements.
revision_ledger_policy: Default all dimensions zero; partial hit/cont/act dictionary fills missing keys with zero; unknown keys, bools, noninteger or values outside 0/1 rejected; input ledger is not mutated.

test_cases: partial core labels preserve per-dimension observations
one revision blocks only its own dimension

known_issues: No real Li observations were provided or filled in this worker task.
Root owns CLI integration, fixed-order PDF/cards, documentation, actual evaluation and final acceptance.
basic_consistency=null denotes unresolved observations rather than treating blank or missing as disagreement.
root_validation: Full suite 71 passed + 8 subtests; empty real-label evaluation awaiting_labels; no scores/config/calendar/data writes
